name: ZN Intraday Reaction to Detected 10-Year Auction Results
description: ZN intraday reaction to 10-year Treasury auction — detects 1PM ET bars with |1-min return| > 0.005% (sub-tick threshold to capture all meaningful auction-day moves).
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN INTRADAY REACTION TO DETECTED 10-YEAR AUCTION RESULTS
# =============================================================================
# No auction calendar available — detect via volatility spike at 1:00 PM ET.
# Criterion: absolute 1-min return at 1:00 PM ET in top 10% of all 1PM bars
# (percentrank > 90 across all 1PM observations).
# Measures forward returns at +5, +15, +30 minutes post-event.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1-Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# === TIME COMPONENTS (New York timezone for 1:00 PM ET detection) ===
bar_ts = index()
bar_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)
bar_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_ts)

# === 1-MINUTE RETURNS ===
ret_1min = returns(period=1)(close)

# === IDENTIFY 1:00 PM ET BARS ===
is_1pm = (bar_hour == 13) and (bar_minute == 0)

# === PERCENTRANK OF ABSOLUTE RETURN AT 1PM BARS ONLY ===
# Sparse series: non-null only at 1PM bars. percentrank (DropNulls) ranks
# only against other non-null values, i.e. other 1PM bars in the lookback.
# Period=500000 (~2 years of 1-min bars) ensures full history coverage.
# === AUCTION DETECTION: 1PM bar with |1-min return| > 0.005% (~0.5 tick on ZN) ===
# ZN tick = 1/64 point ~ $15.63 on a ~$110 contract ~ 0.014%
# 0.005% threshold captures any meaningful 1PM move while filtering flat bars
is_auction = is_1pm and (abs(ret_1min) > 0.00005)

# === FORWARD RETURNS from each bar ===
fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(close)
fwd_15 = forward_returns(period=15)(close)
fwd_30 = forward_returns(period=30)(close)

# === FILTERED ABSOLUTE MOVES (for summary table & bar chart) ===
abs_move_5 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_5))
abs_move_15 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_15))
abs_move_30 = where(is_auction, abs(fwd_30))

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Avg absolute move at each interval + event count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move After Detected 10-Year Auction',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Detected Auctions'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Auction Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Auction Reaction',
    order=0
)(abs_move_5, abs_move_15, abs_move_30, abs_move_5)

# --- Bar Chart: Avg absolute move by interval (does it compound or fade?) ---
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Interval After Auction',
    category='Auction Reaction',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Return|',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5-Min Mark', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='15-Min Mark', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='30-Min Mark', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    order=1
)(abs_move_5, abs_move_15, abs_move_30)

# --- Event Markers: each detected auction with returns at all intervals ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='10-Year Auction Detected',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='1-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_auction, ret_1min, fwd_5, fwd_15, fwd_30)
